post.description: Creating a report requires current content admission. The authenticated reporter may add evidence to their own waiting report after qualification expires or facts become unavailable. Closed reports require admission again. Responses contain only the request receipt and never target content. Resource copyright complaints are registered by the resources module through its trusted port using the same report receipt and idempotency format; this generic HTTP report endpoint still requires admission.

previous_task_id.description: Required for appeal; identifies the original applied task. Other request kinds must omit it.

Submission.description: Reports and author requests require an authenticated user; review tasks may only be opened by a moderator in the object school. Appeals require the content owner and a previous applied task; the service verifies the relationship and current eligibility.
